excerpt.zh:
铝板上雕刻的坐标大体准确。

这是太阳系，而这块铝板显然来自被我们宇航员标记为太阳系-III的那颗行星。
excerpt.en:
The directions inferred from the inscribed plaque were largely accurate.

This is the system of Sol, with the plaque apparently originating from the planet our astronomers have labeled Sol III.

triggers.en: When a fleet enters a system

texts.zh:
铝板上雕刻的坐标大体准确。

这是太阳系，而这块铝板显然来自被我们宇航员标记为太阳系-III的那颗行星。
texts.en:
The directions inferred from the inscribed plaque were largely accurate.

This is the system of Sol, with the plaque apparently originating from the planet our astronomers have labeled Sol III.

texts.zh: 我们已经找到了那些可疑破旧金属废料的源头。太阳系是一个以一颗黄矮星为中心的小星系，一个和[Root.Owner.GetName]的辉煌毫不相称的穷乡僻壤。
texts.en: We have found the alleged source of the tacky metal scrap we recovered. The system of Sol is a pinprick in space centered on a pitiful yellow dwarf, a backwater completely eclipsed by the splendor of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们最终到达了太阳系，那里的人在沥尽心血地用极其原始的方式与外界交流。铝板所标记的源头似乎是从恒星往外数第三块岩石，应该是一颗大陆行星。
texts.en: We have finally reached the system of Sol, a destination some being went to great pains to communicate through a very primitive medium. The plaque's point of origin is seemingly the third rock from the sun, which should be a continental planet.

label.zh: 发表声明。然后把铝板丢到他们的恒星里去。
label.en: Make a statement. Jettison the plaque into their sun.

label.zh: 你们向虚空呼唤，我们便来了。
label.en: You shouted into the void, and we came.
